name: daftpunk-house
synth_class: analog mono with square + saw oscillators, ladder/OTA filter

patch_notes.filter: cutoff 50-60%, resonance 30%, env amount on filter 20-30% (subtle filter open on attack)
patch_notes.envelope_amp: fast attack, full sustain, medium release
patch_notes.envelope_filter: fast attack, short decay (filter snaps back), low sustain
patch_notes.lfo: off — slide character comes from glide/portamento on phrases, NOT LFO modulation
patch_notes.performance: groove sits on 4-on-the-floor; bass plays root + fifth + octave with slight glide between notes
